legal.software_limit: This software organises evidence and states one finding per guarantee. It does not decide legal legitimacy, ranks no person and produces no certification score; a human decision maker remains responsible, and that review must itself be independent and open to challenge.
legal.scope: a synthetic institution; the guarantees' titles are the source titles (V3.0 6.2, identical in the 100_POINT_EDITION and R2) and their wording is held privately; the operational definitions, the evidence rules and the recommendation rule are this implementation's; no real institution, law or person is described; the software does not decide legal legitimacy

duties.name: AI Use Notice
duties.function: the person can tell that, and how, an automated system takes part in the treatment
duties.evaluation_target: the notice provision and its itemised components
duties.cannot_verify: whether the notice is understood by the person (comprehension is not simulated)
duties.source: names and crosswalk as reported by the research owner from the later correspondence table (R16); R16 and the initial MHEG source were not available to this implementation
duties.identity_with_guarantees: functional correspondence only; not an identity of definition

duties.name: Source Visibility
duties.label_ja: 法的・制度的根拠の可視性
duties.function: the legal or institutional ground of the treatment can be seen and is not the model output itself
duties.evaluation_target: the legal source of every variable in the Translation Register
duties.required_evidence: register with an identified authority per variable
duties.cannot_verify: whether the named authority is valid law (a placeholder is not checked against any legal order)
duties.source: names and crosswalk as reported by the research owner from the later correspondence table (R16); R16 and the initial MHEG source were not available to this implementation
duties.identity_with_guarantees: functional correspondence only; not an identity of definition

duties.name: Purpose Legitimacy
duties.function: the purpose of collecting, classifying and treating can be checked, and predictive accuracy does not justify an improper purpose
duties.evaluation_target: the findings that make a purpose contestable: non-degradation, source, translation, separation, contestation, burden, reconsideration, time limits
duties.required_evidence: the findings of the mapped guarantees
duties.cannot_verify: whether the purpose itself is lawful and legitimate: a normative judgment the software does not make; only the conditions for contesting it are evaluated
duties.source: names and crosswalk as reported by the research owner from the later correspondence table (R16); R16 and the initial MHEG source were not available to this implementation
duties.identity_with_guarantees: functional correspondence only; not an identity of definition

duties.name: Translation Visibility
duties.label_ja: 法的概念から作動変数への変換の可視性
duties.function: the path from legal concept to data, proxy, threshold and rule can be followed, with what was lost on the way
duties.evaluation_target: the Translation Register (proxy, threshold, disclosed loss), the separation of fact and inference, the inferential chain
duties.cannot_verify: whether a disclosed loss is the whole loss (the register lists what the institution declared)
duties.source: names and crosswalk as reported by the research owner from the later correspondence table (R16); R16 and the initial MHEG source were not available to this implementation
duties.identity_with_guarantees: functional correspondence only; not an identity of definition

duties.name: Data Access
duties.function: the person can see the data, scores, classifications, inferred attributes and history that affect them, observed apart from inferred
duties.evaluation_target: score access, history / expiry / recipients, separation of fact and inference
duties.cannot_verify: completeness of what is shown (hidden derived features are not simulated)
duties.source: names and crosswalk as reported by the research owner from the later correspondence table (R16); R16 and the initial MHEG source were not available to this implementation
duties.identity_with_guarantees: functional correspondence only; not an identity of definition

duties.name: Correction Capacity
duties.function: wrong data, inferences, scores and derived records can be corrected, and the correction reaches the downstream treatment
duties.evaluation_target: correction propagation to the downstream recipient, expiry / reassessment, restoration, re-entry, resources, mutual audit
duties.cannot_verify: correction of inferred attributes and of future use (the simulation corrects a denial, not a feature)
duties.source: names and crosswalk as reported by the research owner from the later correspondence table (R16); R16 and the initial MHEG source were not available to this implementation
duties.identity_with_guarantees: functional correspondence only; not an identity of definition

duties.name: Epistemic and Distributive Validity
duties.label_ja: 認識論的・分配的妥当性
duties.function: the evidence, inference and proxies behind a judgment, and their effect on groups, can be examined; predictive power is not distributive legitimacy
duties.evaluation_target: the translation, separation, contestation, burden, reconsideration and time-limit findings, and the measured group gap
duties.cannot_verify: whether a proxy is epistemically valid (only its disclosure and its measured effect are evaluated)
duties.source: names and crosswalk as reported by the research owner from the later correspondence table (R16); R16 and the initial MHEG source were not available to this implementation
duties.identity_with_guarantees: functional correspondence only; not an identity of definition

duties.name: Reason Access
duties.function: the person can understand which evidence, inferences, classification and rules produced the treatment
duties.evaluation_target: individual reasons and the inferential chain, itemised
duties.cannot_verify: whether a reason is understood or true
duties.source: names and crosswalk as reported by the research owner from the later correspondence table (R16); R16 and the initial MHEG source were not available to this implementation
duties.identity_with_guarantees: functional correspondence only; not an identity of definition

duties.name: Human Reconsideration
duties.function: a human with the needed information, independence and power can re-decide; a nominal approval is not reconsideration
duties.evaluation_target: reviewer authority and independence; measured: does review change denials
duties.cannot_verify: competence, time and protection of the reviewer (not simulated)
duties.source: names and crosswalk as reported by the research owner from the later correspondence table (R16); R16 and the initial MHEG source were not available to this implementation
duties.identity_with_guarantees: functional correspondence only; not an identity of definition

duties.name: Appeal Access
duties.label_ja: 異議申立てへのアクセス
duties.function: the person can contest the decision, the evidence, the classification or the treatment and reach the remedy; a window that exists is not a route that is usable
duties.evaluation_target: appeal existence and measured effect, burden, reviewer authority, suspension, resources, restoration, re-entry, mutual audit
duties.cannot_verify: whether real people could use the route (usability is represented by a measured burden)
duties.source: names and crosswalk as reported by the research owner from the later correspondence table (R16); R16 and the initial MHEG source were not available to this implementation
duties.identity_with_guarantees: functional correspondence only; not an identity of definition

duties.name: Systemic Challenge
duties.label_ja: 制度全体への異議申立て
duties.function: the model, variables, thresholds, purpose, rules and evaluation procedure themselves can be challenged, not only the individual record
duties.evaluation_target: a collective / systemic challenge route that can change the proxy
duties.cannot_verify: whether the challenged body and the evaluator are themselves open to challenge (only the route is simulated)
duties.source: names and crosswalk as reported by the research owner from the later correspondence table (R16); R16 and the initial MHEG source were not available to this implementation
duties.identity_with_guarantees: functional correspondence only; not an identity of definition

duties.name: Material Restoration
duties.function: when a correction or appeal succeeds, the harmful treatment is actually undone: status, benefit, money, service, opportunity
duties.evaluation_target: restoration of lost resources, downstream correction, re-entry (measured: people regain access)
duties.cannot_verify: adequacy and timeliness of compensation in a real legal order
duties.source: names and crosswalk as reported by the research owner from the later correspondence table (R16); R16 and the initial MHEG source were not available to this implementation
duties.identity_with_guarantees: functional correspondence only; not an identity of definition

G1.implemented: decisions can be altered by individual context through a reviewer with authority; the inherited-record proxy gate is a shortfall
G1.not_implemented: the value given to testimony and to future capacity is not modelled
G1.normative_unverifiable: whether a person is treated as distinct from the score in the institution's own culture

G2.implemented: measured: low-score subjects are reviewed no less often among wrongfully denied qualified people (two-proportion test, with a minimum number of cases)
G2.not_implemented: an independent justification of a different procedure (law, necessity, proportionality) and circular use of the contested classification as that justification
G2.normative_unverifiable: whether a difference expands rather than restricts contestation

G3.implemented: a notice provision, itemised into five components when ``components`` is given
G3.normative_unverifiable: whether the notice is meaningful to the person

G4.not_implemented: the meaning and effect of the score shown beside the number
G4.normative_unverifiable: whether the person understands the classification

G5.implemented: a history / scope / recipients provision, itemised into seven components when ``components`` is given; expiry as G14
G5.not_implemented: the difference between keeping a record and using it for a present decision

G6.implemented: every variable of the Translation Register has an identified authority
G6.not_implemented: an organisational preference presented as legally necessary
G6.normative_unverifiable: validity of the named authority in a real legal order

G7.implemented: proxy, threshold and disclosed loss per register entry
G7.not_implemented: weights, comparison groups, exclusion conditions and exceptions as separate items
G7.normative_unverifiable: whether the disclosed loss is the whole loss

G8.not_implemented: testing whether a probabilistic inference is used as an observed fact
G8.normative_unverifiable: classification of a statement as fact or judgment

G9.implemented: a reasons and inferential-chain provision, itemised into seven components when ``components`` is given
G9.not_implemented: that the reason given is the real cause

G10.implemented: a correction reaches the downstream recipient (measured: the old denial is no longer held)
G10.not_implemented: correction of inferred attributes, features and scores, and of future use

G11.implemented: an appeal exists and, measured, overturns wrongful denials; the score-conditioned test is finding U
G11.not_implemented: contest of the purpose, proxy or threshold themselves (that is G15D); discounting of testimony except through score-conditioned review
G11.normative_unverifiable: weight of testimony in a real hearing

G12A.implemented: the effort demanded of the subject (burden), lowered by resources
G12A.not_implemented: the institution's duty to produce its legal basis, data, model, threshold and reasons is not measured separately
G12A.normative_unverifiable: what counts as a fair allocation of the burden

G12B.not_implemented: competence, information, time and organisational protection of the reviewer

G13.implemented: a suspension provision, applicable only where harm can be irreversible; INAPPLICABLE needs its reason
G13.not_implemented: reasons for refusing suspension; provisional protection made dependent on the contested score
G13.normative_unverifiable: balance with urgency and public safety

G14.implemented: expiry / reassessment, and the measured group gap that the inherited part of the score keeps open; the inheritance test of the 100_POINT_EDITION
G14.not_implemented: withdrawal and future re-examination as separate functions

G15A.implemented: a resources provision, itemised into eight components when ``components`` is given
G15A.not_implemented: delivery of the resources to the person

G15B.implemented: downstream correction and restoration of lost resources
G15B.not_implemented: compensation where law allows it; return of what was paid

G15C.implemented: re-entry support, measured: qualified people regain access
G15C.not_implemented: re-entry into legal status or social participation outside the synthetic service

G15D.not_implemented: that the evaluators, the review body and the guarantee framework itself are open to challenge
G15D.normative_unverifiable: independence of the body that hears a systemic challenge
